ads.caption: We provide manufacturing ERP (enterprise resource planning). Fabless (chip design without owning a fabrication plant) planning teams: reconcile demand changes with outsourced-lot reports before discussing the next plan.

cards.headline: Demand changed. Which lots matter?
cards.body: Identify the outsourced lots linked to the changed demand before discussing the plan with production partners.
cards.alt: Illustration: Demand changed. Which lots matter?

cards.headline: Start with product and planning period.
cards.body: Agree which product, planning period and outsourced lots the demand change concerns.
cards.native_headline: Start with product and planning period.
cards.alt: Illustration: Start with product and planning period.

cards.headline: When was this lot status recorded?
cards.body: Check the report time and source alongside lot status before using it in a planning discussion.
cards.native_headline: When was this lot status recorded?
cards.alt: Illustration: When was this lot status recorded?

cards.headline: What needs confirmation from the partner?
cards.body: List missing information and who will confirm it with each production partner before discussing changes.
cards.native_headline: What needs confirmation from the partner?
cards.alt: Illustration: What needs confirmation from the partner?

cards.headline: Give replanning a shared basis.
cards.body: Bring scope, report source and confirmation owners into the same planning discussion.

ERP business management and MES (manufacturing execution system) production context.

cards.headline: Consulting and implementation in Vietnam
cards.body: Work with our team in Vietnam on ERP consulting and implementation. Start with your reporting workflows, update ownership and project priorities.
